requirements.text: Decomposer contract states the per-`SUB-n`-block (40 lines) and total (220 lines) budgets for `02_subtasks.md`.
Decomposer instructed to stay within both budgets by cutting implementation-detail prose, never by dropping an acceptance scenario or retiring a sub-task.
Writer contract states the total-line budget (140 lines) for `01_charter.md`.
Writer instructed to stay within budget without dropping an outcome, a constraint, or a non-goal.
Reviewer checklist gains a row flagging an overrun, routed to the owning role by artifact, naming the block/measured-vs-allowed size.
The overrun check blocks in every round irrespective of WF-551's changed-text rule, stated as a named exception beside that rule.
Decomposer: an irreducible overrun is reported as a product choice on `Flags:`, content kept, never truncated.
Writer: the symmetric case is recorded under `## Open questions`, never truncated.
Rationale for the chosen numbers lives in the `references/` doc, not the runtime bodies.
AC1 — a `02_subtasks.md` with one `SUB-n` block over its per-block budget → reviewer emits one finding for check 15, routed to `decomposer`, naming the block and measured vs. allowed size.
AC2 — `02_subtasks.md` over its total budget with every block within its own budget → one finding routed to `decomposer`.
AC3 — `01_charter.md` over its total budget → one finding routed to `charter-writer`, naming measured vs. allowed size.
AC4 — both artifacts within budget → no finding from this check.
AC5 — a decomposer revision that successfully brings `02_subtasks.md` back within budget (without removing acceptance scenarios or retiring sub-tasks) reports the change in its output block.
AC6 — a writer revision that successfully brings `01_charter.md` back within budget (without dropping an outcome/constraint/non-goal) reports the change in its output block.
AC7 — an irreducible overrun: decomposer keeps the content, leaves the overrun, reports it as a product choice on `Flags:`, never truncates.
Out-of-scope items correctly left untouched — no budget added to the review log; scope-freeze, WF-551's convergence rules, and the cap gate are untouched.
Exact numeric budgets are grounded in the converged corpus (`C025–C028` decompositions at 112–220 lines; charters at 107–140 lines).
Core stays domain-free.
Reviewer stays read-only.
`SKILL.md`, if touched, ends no higher than its line count at the start of this slice.
Version bump follows the charter tier rule (PATCH by default; MINOR only if a shape must change).
Touched files are limited to the three role agents, the `references/` doc, and the two version manifests.
